mechanism: Propylthiouracil reduces thyroid hormone synthesis, and propranolol's metabolism may be altered in hypothyroid states; propranolol also masks tachycardia symptoms of hyperthyroidism, potentially delaying PTU efficacy assessment.
action: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, and thyroid function regularly; adjust propranolol dose as thyroid status normalizes to avoid beta-blocker accumulation and bradycardia.
